prereg.G1_cert_anchors: S(logical) in [2.40,2.85] & >2 at >=5 sigma (196 band); S(relay) in [2.30,2.75] & >2 at >=5 sigma (197 measured 2.6046); S(nocx) in [-0.25,0.30]
prereg.G2_key_exists: QBER_Z and QBER_X < 0.11 in logical, relay, bare, barerelay; nocx QBER_Z and QBER_X in [0.45,0.55] (executed no-entanglement null: no weld, no secret)
prereg.G3_shield_quality: r(logical) > r(bare) at >=3 sigma AND r(relay) > r(barerelay) at >=3 sigma (delta-method SE); QBER_Z(relay) < QBER_Z(barerelay) at >=5 sigma
prereg.G4_depth_pays: [r(relay)-r(barerelay)] > [r(logical)-r(bare)] at >=3 sigma — the shield's key advantage GROWS with depth (the invention thesis; a miss is a finding against Invention 1, kept)
prereg.G5_gauges: acceptance >= 0.70 every basis (logical/nocx, 196 gate); >= 0.50 every basis (relay, 12q/3-block); throughput column reported both links (reported, not gated — the honest toll)
prereg.budget_predictions: QBER_Z(logical) in [0.005,0.025]; QBER_Z(relay) in [0.025,0.060]; r(relay)/r(barerelay) in [1.8,5.0]; crossover pattern (conf 0.6): bare wins throughput on the direct link, logical wins throughput on the relay link
prereg.scope: trusted-device BBM92; CHSH = tier-2 health certificate NOT DI (F115); raw sifted + asymptotic r; no EC/PA/auth; deterministic settings
